headline_en: Iranian govt $61M seizure plus 8 new incidents
briefing_ko:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** (—) — $6.57M 탈취, 원인 미확인.
- **[Revolut](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409635)** (Monero) — 6000 XMR(≈$3M) 요구, 아직 지급 안 됨.
- **[GalaChain](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409685)** (GalaChain) — 서명 재사용 공격으로 9개 지갑에서 $3M 탈취.
- **Iranian Government** — $61M 암호화폐 IRGC 자금 세탁 의심 압류, 주소 등재 없음.
- **소액** — Startale $2.9K, BonfireSwap $47K.
- **시사점** — 재사용 서명·플래시 론 등 기존 취약점이 연속적으로 악용되고 있음.
briefing_en:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** — $6.57M stolen, method unknown.
- **[Revolut](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409635)** (Monero) — ransomware gang demanded 6,000 XMR (~$3M), no payment made.
- **[GalaChain](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409685)** (GalaChain) — reused failed signatures let attacker drain $3M from nine wallets.
- **Iranian Government** — $61M crypto seized as alleged IRGC oil-sale proceeds; no addresses listed.
- **Smaller** — Startale $2.9K, BonfireSwap $47K.
- **Takeaway** — Attackers keep exploiting signature reuse and flash-loan price manipulation.
